digest.component_or_area: LLM failure messaging / rebar CLI outcome reporting
propositions: Content policy / guardrail blocks are reported to operators with a misleading generic message stating 'too large / malformed' instead of naming the actual cause (content filter / policy intervention).

ResolutionClass.CHANGE_INPUT is correctly assigned to content-filter denials, but the operator-facing message string does not distinguish them from genuine size/format errors (HTTP 413, context length).

message_for() must accept an optional finish_reason parameter and return a specific content-filter message when both resolution_class is CHANGE_INPUT and finish_reason is 'content_filter', while preserving backward compatibility and the existing generic message for other CHANGE_INPUT cases.
The finish_reason value is available at all three message render sites (LLMOutcome.diagnostic, persisted coverage diagnostic) and must be threaded through the call stack.
Resolution class, retryable flag, and exit-code behavior must remain unchanged; this is a messaging-only refinement.
